corpus.source_pdfs: /home/mahmoud/Desktop/AI_Projects/UktubAI/test_papers/{RF,smarthome}/*.pdf (84 MB, owner's library — NOT in this repo)
corpus.note: Text files are derived from the owner's PDFs; extract locally with the command above. Claims quote 10-40-word passages from those texts (scholarly quotation).

schema.paper: text file basename (which paper the claim is checked against)
schema.claim: single-sentence, standalone, present tense, reworded (never copied from the paper)
schema.label: TRUE = paper explicitly states/entails it; FALSE = contradicts or fabricates
schema.evidence: verbatim 10-40-word quote from the paper supporting the label

rules: claims are decidable from that paper alone (no outside knowledge)
TRUE claims are reworded, never sentence-copies
FALSE = contradicted OR plausible fabrication (right magnitude, wrong value)
every claim carries a verbatim evidence quote; a claim whose quote is not found in the paper is dropped

provenance.engine_results: per-run results JSON lands next to the dated report in docs/benchmarks/
